scores.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a test and updating one spec file, completely failing to modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to actually implement usage accumulation. Consequently, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` will fail at runtime because the orchestrator still only reports the last round's usage. Furthermore, the candidate failed to update `CHANGELOG.md` and did not update the `afterModelResponse` signature in `OrchestratorHooks` (which the reference renamed to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`), leaving the majority of the acceptance criteria unfulfilled. Finally, the candidate left behind an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` artifact and created a separate test file instead of adding tests to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
